title: Coanalytic subfields and bases of prescribed dimension
summary: Assuming $V=L$, we construct proper coanalytic subfields of $\mathbb{R}$ and coanalytic Hamel and transcendence bases of every possible Hausdorff dimension, uniformly in the relevant parameters. There is a single lightface $Π^1_1$ set $G\subseteq[0,1]\times\mathbb{R}$ whose sections $A_α$ are proper subfields with $\dim_{\mathrm H}A_α=α$, form a strictly increasing chain, and satisfy $A_α=\bigcup_{β 0$. For every $n\ge1$, every countable subfield $K\subseteq\mathbb{R}$ and every $s\in[0,n]$, we construct a coanalytic Hamel basis of $\mathbb{R}^n$ over $K$ of Hausdorff dimension $s$.…
